about: What the served scores rest on (ADR 0048). Registered results are those of the locked test of Step 11 (docs/results.md); the served model itself has no reported metric.

served_model.name: trialpulse-m4
served_model.description: M4 with the tuned settings, fitted on all available data (the final cohort, with the origin set to the day after the data cutoff). It is a new fit: no metric of it is reported, and every number below comes from the per-origin models of Step 11.

covid_stress_test.description: AUC at 12 months at the 2020 origin minus the mean of 2018 and 2019

falsified_hypotheses.result: M4 minus M1, AUC at landmark 0: -0.0027 (-0.0166 to +0.0114) at 12 months and -0.0013 (-0.0098 to +0.0075) at 24 months

falsified_hypotheses.statement: Operational stops are ranked better than scientific ones
falsified_hypotheses.result: Operational minus scientific AUC at 12 months: +0.0229 (-0.0025 to +0.0494)

known_limitations: The 24-month calibration is below the registered range (slopes 0.7818 and 0.7325): predicted risks are spread too widely (ADR 0032).
Registry metadata cannot anticipate safety and efficacy stops, which are scientific outcomes.
Scores describe elevated early-stop risk of a trial portfolio; they are not about whether a treatment works and are not medical advice.

served_scope.between_landmarks: Every feature is computed on the scoring date, with the two time features held at the last landmark passed (ADR 0034).
served_scope.flagged_trials: Trials 42 to 119 months after registration are scored as at landmark 6 and flagged. Their development AUC at 12 months was 0.7336 (42 to 59 months) and 0.7271 (60 to 119 months), against 0.7161 at landmark 6.
served_scope.flag_note: Flagged scores ran above the observed risk in development (for example 4.2% against 2.8% for 60 to 119 months at the 2017 origin), so they may overstate the risk. Flagged scores never enter a headline number.
served_scope.not_scored: Trials 120 months or more after registration, trials of an age band that failed its check, and trials with a visible status reversal get a reason code and no score.
